title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring within-group pairwise distance gaps and response distribution alignment (KL divergence) between simulated LLM agents and human respondents across various demographic categories (e.g., sex, birth year, marital status, employment) to quantify diversity collapse and identity essentialism.

Projecting survey responses into a 2D PCA space and computing silhouette scores to evaluate the degree of within-group compression and between-group separation among different socioeconomic status groups.
